notes.title: Gamecan is releasing a new original title in 2025!
notes.notes:
Since April 2024, we have been working on "Oh, Hel No!" ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225370/Oh_Hel_No/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227235/51e2cc47ed5802fd2d30b0dc8244fcb9232f4d64.png[/img]

[b]Who is it for? [/b]Players who enjoy the quaint and menial tasks of crafting games in a relaxed pace, and the methodical preparation before the rush of an action-packed hardcore battle.

[b]Oh, Hel no![/b] is a [b]top-down, survival-crafting game[/b] where the ultimate goal is to conquer Hel through a series of tough, horde-survival battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227235/e1fd2313fce81e288544f02b80a8be28e568ba81.png[/img]

[b]You and your friends[/b] take the role of Imps cast out of Hel into the Overworld. Explore a world that is both procedurally-generated and handcrafted, filled with different biomes and engaging encounters. Gather resources, build your base, craft tools and armor, and become stronger to survive your trips to Hel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227235/aa761efd99340bffb60d17bf0bf6cbc559d9c01b.png[/img]

Specialize your character to complement your playstyle. Play as a tank, so you can be in the frontlines and protect your teammates from harm. Play as a forager to provide the team with more resources to craft essential gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227235/c5b77b8b6c809fd4191d12cca795f65e08f95346.png[/img]

Play as a ‘warrior’ to dispatch enemies effortlessly with the might of your steel. And many more. Gain power solo or with a team, defeat the underworld's champion, and claim victory over Hel.

[b]WHAT MAKES THIS GAME UNIQUE?[/b]

Imagine a [b]perfect mix between Animal Crossing and Vampire Survivors[/b], where you leisurely build your Overworld and then confront the evils within Hel using the things you've created.

Oh, Hel No! offers a unique blend of slow-paced gameplay, involving resource gathering and survival crafting, combined with the fast-paced action of the emerging horde-survival genre. The stylized low-poly visuals, with a touch of diorama-esque design, emphasize clarity, approachability, and atmosphere.

If OHNO looks fun, we accept wishlists and coffee ːsteamthisː

notes.title: OUR AUGUST PLAYTEST IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Gladiators!

Our August Playtest for Contenders: Arena is LIVE NOW and will run until Sunday, August 13th! WE have worked hard to address feedback from the July session and are excited to share all of the improvements! 

Updates & Improvements:
Ability balancing & Improvements
Weapon balancing & Improvements
Added Heat gain feed
Updated Animations across 3 Gladiators
Added New Weapon Animations
Added User Profile UI
Updated Challenge tracking
HUD Improvements
- Updated Pre-Match and Half-Time screens
Updated Tutorial
- Improved feedback and guiding systems
- Ability to replay Time Trials with all 3 gladiators types
Customization System fixes

Known issues:
Server crashes (we are working on resolving this).
Challenge rewards sometimes do not display upon receiving the reward (It reflects after you exit and re-open the game).
Reconnecting players cause lag spikes
A very rare bug that has a possibility of having 4 players in 1 team.

PLAYTEST TIME
Servers open - Wednesday 9th August at 17:00 CEST (8 AM PDT)
Servers close - Sunday 13th August at 19:00 CEST (11 AM PDT)

Feedback forms will follow after the playtest concludes.

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Step into the ARENA!
notes.notes:
Salutations Gladiators,

We are absolutely psyched to announce our first CLOSED Technical Test for Contenders: Arena, kicking off on Friday 16.06.2023 and running for 3 days straight!

We are accepting 300 players for the first test

PLAYTEST TIME

The Contenders Arena Closed Playtest is live from:

[b]Servers open - Friday 16th June 17:00 CEST (8am PDT)[/b]

[b]Servers close - Sunday 18th Junel 19:00 CEST (11am PDT)[/b]

So, why should you play Contenders: Arena next weekend?

[list]
[*] [b]The absolutely upgraded Overstep experience[/b]
You loved the DIY acrobatic shooter from a hobbyist team. Now come check out how much of a difference a full time team makes.

[*] [b]Three classes[/b]
Yes, we have three classes now! Support, Assault (Hunter) and Tank. The rock, paper, scissors dynamic has added a vast amount of tactics into the game.

[*] [b]Opportunity to help balance and build the game[/b]
We plan to support this game for years to come. Let's work together to make it a balanced and fun experience for both casual and competitive players. [/list]

[b]THE ARENA IS OPEN[/b]
For the best experience we recommend playing during these hours:

[b]18:00 - 21:00 CEST[/b]
